help.goal: Guess the hidden five letter word in six tries. In Race everyone hunts the same word and fewest guesses wins.
steps: Tap letters on the on-screen keyboard to fill five boxes.
Tap ENTER to send the guess, or ⌫ to fix a letter.
Check the green, yellow and grey tiles before your next guess.
Keep going until you solve it or spend all six tries.
notes: Green means right letter in the right spot. Yellow means the letter is in the word somewhere else.
Grey means that letter is not in the word at all. The keyboard keys tint the same way.
A guess that is not a real word shakes and costs you nothing.
